phrases.context: A standard and polite greeting to inquire about someone's well-being.

phrases.english: Good morning, may your morning be blessed.
phrases.context: Used to greet someone in the morning, with the second part being a common reply.

phrases.english: Good evening, may your evening be pleasant.
phrases.context: Used to greet someone in the evening, similar to the morning greeting.

phrases.english: Goodbye, I will see you later.
phrases.context: A polite way to say farewell when you expect to meet the person again.
